question: Therapeutic misadventure and medical negligence are legally equivalent terms — both describe an adverse outcome and both attract the same standard of liability.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. They are legally distinct. Therapeutic misadventure is an unexpected adverse outcome from properly conducted treatment — it does not imply negligence. Negligence requires breach of the standard of care. The distinction matters critically for documentation and legal defence.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Therapeutic misadventure is an adverse outcome from treatment conducted to an appropriate standard; it is not negligence. Negligence requires a demonstrable breach. The two concepts carry very different legal consequences.
